race.comment: SAMAKA (2) sets the standard on exposed form, having placed in all four starts and resumed with a third at Newcastle when beaten just under a length as a dominant odds-on favourite. That provincial form looks the strongest and he can make an immediate impact for the new stable. BIG STORM (15) is lightly raced and resumed with a Bendigo third after giving away ground early, so there is scope for natural second-up improvement. ACCOLADES (4) brings a different profile as a first starter, backed by a close second in his latest Albury trial, barrier 1 and a $100,000 purchase tag. McDougall riding adds substance and he can make an impression. PRINCE OF GLAM (7) is another debutant with enough trial grounding, including a Wodonga trial win, and looks capable of making a competitive start to his career. MAGIC ROYALE (11) couldn't reel in Hazardous last start but rates well off that effort. Include.
